Read and Answer.main_question: Read the passage and answer the questions
Read and Answer.passage: Hamza lives in a small town near the hills. Every morning, he feeds the birds in his garden. He puts rice and water in a clay bowl. Soon, many birds come to eat. A little green parrot is his favourite. One day, Hamza saw that the bowl was empty. He ran to his mother and asked for more rice. She smiled and gave him a full cup. Hamza was happy. He said, "Sharing food makes my heart feel warm." Now his neighbour Sana helps him feed the birds too.

slots.instruction_en: Read the passage and answer the questions.
slots.prompt_rule: One new passage of 80 to 110 words in "passage", on a book theme, in Grade 2 words. "questions": ten objects { question, answer, marks: 2, scheme } — four recall, four understand, two apply — where scheme.points sum to 2. Do not prefix a question with a letter.
Three book words. Answer: a model sentence; accept any correct sentence using the word.

Three book words. Answer: one rhyme; accept lists other real rhymes. Each item also carries picture: {kind:"object", name} of the given word, in English for the artist; choose only words that can be drawn. The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.

slots.instruction_en: Look at the picture and write the word.
slots.prompt_rule: Two book objects as picture: {kind:"object", name}. Answer: the word. The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.
Three sentences with one blank; options exactly is, am, are.

Three book words with one or two letters blank, one underscore for each missing letter ("b__k" for book, "man_o" for mango); the picture is the clue. Answer: the full word. Each item also carries picture: {kind:"object", name} of the answer word, in English for the artist; choose only words that can be drawn. The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.
Three book adjectives or verbs. Answer: the opposite.

Three book nouns (one -es, one irregular). Answer: the plural. Each item also carries picture: {kind:"object", name} of the given noun, one of it, in English for the artist; choose only words that can be drawn. The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.
Three sentences with one blank; options exactly has, have.

slots.instruction_en: Look at the picture. Write in, on, under, near or behind.
slots.prompt_rule: Five items, each a scene as picture: {kind:"scene", describe} of one object placed by another (a cat under a table), placed in, on, under, near or behind it, never above, over, beside or next to. The describe names the floor and the thing's own legs or base ("a ball on the floor under a chair", "a bird on top of the roof"). Stem: "The cat is ____ the table." Answer: that one word. The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.

slots.instruction_en: Use he, she, it or they.
slots.prompt_rule: Four sentences naming a person or thing; the child rewrites with the pronoun. Answer: the pronoun.
Topic exactly "My House". Answer: a model paragraph of five sentences. Scheme: five K points of 2 — on topic, five sentences, capitals and full stops, spelling, describing words.
Three nouns with a blank before them; options exactly a, an.

slots.instruction_en: Put a full stop (.) or question mark (?).
slots.prompt_rule: Three short sentences with no end mark, each a statement or a question, never an exclamation. Answer: the sentence with its . or ?.

slots.instruction_en: Look at the picture and write three sentences.
slots.prompt_rule: One busy scene from a book theme (a park, a market, a classroom) as picture: {kind:"scene", describe}. Answer: three model sentences. Scheme: three K points of 2 — each a correct sentence about the picture. The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.

slots.instruction_en: Put the sentences in order to make a story.
slots.prompt_rule: One short story of six sentences from a book theme, given out of order and listed in "questions" as plain sentences with no number or letter in front (the paper letters them (a)-(f)). Answer: the order. Scheme: one K point of 1 per sentence in the right place. Write the story so exactly one order is valid; if two orders are really valid, list every valid order in scheme.accept.
